description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

EY is a professional services firm serving clients across financial services and other industries through consulting, technology, assurance, tax, strategy and transaction services. The Backend Engineer will support the design and development of secure, scalable server-side services, APIs and data integrations, contributing to analysis, development, testing and support across the technology delivery lifecycle.
Back-End Software Engineer supporting enterprise technology solutions through development, testing, automation, and production support

Responsibilities:
• You’ll work as part of a project team and will be responsible for the design, build/configuration, testing, analysis, delivery and support of Technology solutions
• The goal is to help clients solve complex business problems by delivering robust enterprise solutions. You will assist with analysis, development, testing, and support, learn the team’s tools and standards, and contribute to assigned workstreams under the guidance of experienced colleagues
• Assist with development, testing, and support tasks, and contribute to assigned workstreams
• Learn and apply the team’s code quality, security, testing, and automation standards
• Eagerness to learn new and rapidly changing technologies
• Willingness and ability to travel up to 30% of the time

Requirements:
• Foundational knowledge of building server-side services, APIs, and integrations using Java, Spring, Spring Boot, and RESTful web services, with support from experienced colleagues
• Foundational knowledge of microservices concepts and messaging or event streaming platforms such as Kafka or JMS
• Foundational knowledge of relational and NoSQL database design and SQL, including writing and tuning queries and stored procedures
• Foundational knowledge of containerization and cloud platforms such as Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, or Azure
• Foundational understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles
• Eagerness to learn new and rapidly changing technologies
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
• A minimum of 1 year of relevant experience in enterprise application development
• Exposure to Java, Spring, and Spring Boot, and object-oriented programming fundamentals
• Foundational knowledge of building and consuming RESTful APIs
• Familiarity with JSON, XML, REST, SOAP, and web services
• Exposure to SQL and relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, or PostgreSQL
• Familiarity with messaging platforms such as Kafka or JMS
• Exposure to Git, CI/CD, and unit testing concepts
• Comfortable working in Agile environments and collaborating with business and technical stakeholders
• a self-starter and quick learner
• a strong background in computer science from both theoretical and practical points of view

Preferred:
• Experience with the following technologies
• Java, Spring, Spring Boot, and microservices architectures
• RESTful and SOAP web services and API design
• JSON and XML data formats
• SQL and NoSQL databases, and data access frameworks such as JPA or Hibernate
• Messaging and event streaming platforms such as Kafka, JMS, or RabbitMQ
• Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure
• Jenkins, Git, and CI/CD pipelines
• JUnit, Mockito, and automated testing frameworks
• Cloud development, production triage, and enterprise application delivery
